# Social Work and Technology Lab

We are a research group who wants to **promote digital social work practice**. 
We study how digital tools can empower social workers and the communities they serve. 
Our mission is to ensure that as technology evolves, it always **respects the heart and intuition** that social workers bring to their practice, truly supporting the **human side of care**.
:::
:::

::: {.container}
## Principles {#principles .section-label}

Our research is guided by a set of principles.

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-4 .grid-card}
[01]{.card-num} 

### Support Expertise

Technology should complement the situated and social knowledge of social workers, not replace human judgment.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .grid-card}
[02]{.card-num} 

### Labor Dignity

We design tools that prioritize the visibility, value, and dignity of social work labor.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .grid-card}
[03]{.card-num} 

### Hybrid Practice

We treat digital and physical interactions as a single, integrated practice.
:::

:::
:::
